craft_evidence.mills: no — momme weights and cloth types named (22 momme charmeuse, crêpe de chine, Liberty fabric), no mill; certifications listed (OEKO-TEX 100, GCS, RWS, GOTS)

craft_evidence.heritage: dated, not placed — founded 2010 as an e-commerce platform; no founder or city on the story page
craft_evidence.reasoning: The story page claims an owned factory since 2015 and the site lists fibre certifications, but no factory location, maker or mill is named and no product page states a country. An unlocated ownership claim plus certifications is a 2; it moves to 4 if the factory can be shown.
